To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of Wikipedia data for named entity disambiguation is feasible and 2) a disambiguation algorithm that maximizes the agreement between the extracted contextual information and the context of the document, as well the agreement among the candidate entities, is effective.

the use of the Wikipedia category structure and a large amount of contextual information from Wikipedia, together with a simple disambiguation algorithm, leads to very high accuracy on both Wikipedia and news articles.

(i) the use of the Wikipedia data for named entity recognition and disambiguation is a promising direction for the future; (ii) a simple disambiguation algorithm, based on the maximization of the agreement of contextual information and category tags, achieves good accuracy; and (iii) the use of Wikipedia data in combination with the Web search engine results improves significantly the disambigulation accuracy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of recognizing and disambiguating named entities in large collections of text documents.
the following question: How can a large encyclopædic collection be used to improve the recognition and disambiguation capabilities of a named entity system?
the following questions: (1) How to efficiently and accurately extract information from a large encylopedic collection such as Wikipedia?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a large-scale system for the recognition of named entities and semantic disambiguating them based on information extracted by a large encyclopedia.
, the proposed method for named entity disambiguation based on Wikipedia is a good approach for the disambiguated entities.
this system is the most successful system for named entity disambiguation in terms of accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are using a very large collection (Wikipedia) to disambiguate the named entities in other documents.
we have built a large scale system that is capable of extracting information from Wikipedia and using it to disambiguate named entities in a variety of documents.
we have developed an open source system that is able to disambiguate named entities in large corpora with high precision.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of the contextual information extracted automatically from Wikipedia, the category information and the disambiguated entities extracted from the Web can be used to improve the performance of a large scale named entity disambiguation system.

a large encyclopædia such as Wikipedia can be effectively exploited to provide high quality disambiguation results for large scale applications, even when only a small fraction of the entities are explicitly annotated with category labels.
a disambiguation system based on Wikipedia information can achieve high accuracy even without relying on external knowledge bases.
